purpose: Offline grader diagnostics and prospective artifact acceptance; no product runs and no replacement of historical scores

rules.CSV_STRICT: All csv_rows targets must also parse with csv.reader(strict=True); unclosed quoted fields are invalid, while a missing final newline alone is allowed
rules.T03_CHANGELOG_KEYS: T03 prompt requires exactly two top-level keys in change_log.json: changes and unchanged_paths
rules.DECODED_FORBIDDEN_TEXT: For JSON text_excludes targets, inspect decoded JSON strings including keys, in addition to legacy raw-text inspection

acceptance: all frozen legacy artifact checks pass AND all enabled v3 validity guards pass
scoring: No new weighted score. Legacy numeric results are quoted explicitly and never overwrite sealed scores
limits: Synthetic correctness and ablation validate these guards on selected examples; not a proof of full CSV/JSON correctness, product reliability, live Harness causality, or cutoff timing
